# Market brief — Wednesday 2026-10-28 7:30 ET

## Calendar — next 5 market days (chronological)

**Wed 2026-10-28**
- 14:00 ET — FOMC rate decision / statement — hold expected, no SEP
- 14:30 ET — Chair Warsh press conference — inflation and path signals

**Thu 2026-10-29**
- 08:30 ET — Advance Q3 GDP — growth pulse vs ~3% consensus
- 08:30 ET — Sep PCE / Core PCE / income / spending — Fed preferred inflation
- 08:30 ET — Initial / continuing jobless claims — labor market check

**Fri 2026-10-30**
- 08:30 ET — Employment Cost Index Q3 — wage cost pressures
- 09:45 ET — Chicago PMI Oct — regional factory activity

**Mon 2026-11-02**
- 10:00 ET — ISM Manufacturing Oct — factory expansion signal

**Tue 2026-11-03**
- 10:00 ET — JOLTS Sep — job openings / labor demand

No OPEX or witching in this window; next monthly options expiration November 20.

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days

**2026-11-09** — ASTS — Q3 2026 earnings AMC — estimated — earnings calendars
**2026-11-12** — TMC — Q3 2026 earnings AMC — estimated — MarketBeat

ASTS: no dated launch NET or confirmed window published by company or SpaceX in next 30d. BlueBirds 14-16 arrived Cape Canaveral ~October 10 (company post); production through BlueBird 50. Year-end intermittent service target remains (company October 20 update).
TMC: no dated operational, ISA, NOAA process, or Korea Zinc events found in 30d. NOAA certification for USA-A remains an October estimate from prior company guidance. Public warrants ($11.50) expired September 9, 2026.

No published US-China, critical-minerals, ISA, or FCC spectrum meetings with agenda link in the window.

## Insiders — recently reported (ASTS, TMC)

ASTS: Maya Bernal (Chief Accounting Officer) tax withhold (F-code) 3,935 Class A shares at $40.66 on October 17 (filed October 19), remaining direct holding 128,514. No open-market purchases, sales, or 10b5-1 activity in the last 14 days.
TMC: no Form 4/144 in last 14d.

## Rates and bonds

10y ~5.01% (+~2 bp overnight), 2y ~4.75% (+~1 bp), 10y–2y spread ~+26 bp (positive slope, not inverted). 5y TIPS real yield and breakevens not sourceable this morning; nominal yields imply elevated inflation expectations. Growth remains resilient while inflation stays sticky; Fed hold priced above 90% for today, with December hike odds elevated.

## USD/JPY

Spot ~157.90, little changed overnight (-0.04%), rangebound near 157-158 over recent weeks. No fresh intervention or BoJ chatter; tracks US yields into the FOMC.

## Equities tape

SPX closed October 27 at ~7,722.60 (+0.60%), overnight futures flat to +0.1%. QQQ ~721 (+1.27% prior session), IWM ~280 (+1.15%). Distance from ATH not cleanly available; recent peak near current levels. VIX ~17.5, moderate regime. Breadth mixed prior day (A/D near 0.95); equal-weight lagged tech leadership.

## Names / themes only if material overnight

No material headline, filing, or outsized move for ASTS, TMC, critical minerals, or space/spectrum overnight.

## What actually matters this morning

- Today's 14:00 FOMC decision and 14:30 Warsh press conference (hold expected; language on inflation and path can move rates, USDJPY, and vol).
- Thursday 08:30 GDP advance + PCE cluster as post-decision confirmation.
- Yields ticking higher into the meeting with positive curve.
- ASTS estimated earnings November 9; no confirmed launch window in 30d.
- TMC estimated earnings November 12; NOAA process ongoing but no new dated milestone.
